index.title: Company settings
index.subtitle: The policy new loads and invoices are born with. Changing it never rewrites what already exists.

money.title: Money
money.note: A load keeps its own fee and commission from the moment it was agreed. These are only the values the next ones start with.
money.dispatchFeeHint: What you charge the carrier, as a percentage.
money.commissionHint: What the dispatcher earns. Can be overridden per dispatcher.

feeBase.commissionable_base: The gross rate less excluded expenses — permits and escorts do not earn you a fee.
feeBase.carrier_gross_rate: The whole gross rate, expenses included.

numbering.title: Numbering
numbering.note: Prefixes only. Uppercase letters, digits and dashes.
numbering.counters: Next load number: {load}. Next invoice number: {invoice}. Counters cannot be edited here — moving one backwards would repeat an invoice number that has already gone out.

ops.title: Operations
ops.docWarningHint: How far ahead a document counts as expiring soon.
ops.dispatcherAssign: Dispatchers may assign trucks, trailers and drivers to loads
ops.dispatcherAssignHint: Off by default. With it off, only an administrator assigns resources.
ops.oversizeAdmin: Oversize or overweight loads need administrator validation
ops.oversizeAdminHint: With this on, a load flagged oversize or overweight cannot be dispatched until an administrator validates its dimensions and weight on the permits screen — on top of the paperwork being approved. A dispatcher can evaluate it; validating it, no.
ops.fmcsaNotConnected: No FMCSA provider is connected, so nothing is being re-verified — this number is not in effect yet. {count} carrier(s) are past the interval. Connect FMCSA credentials on the server to start.
ops.fmcsaNeverRun: A provider is connected, but nothing has been re-verified yet. Check that the scheduler is running.

contact.title: Public contact details
contact.note: What the public site shows. Not used for anything operational.

retention.note: Retention: records stay active for {months} months, are purged {purge} years after archiving, and financial records are kept {financial} years. Changing retention has legal consequences and is not editable here — ask for it deliberately.

flash.saved: Settings saved. New loads and invoices will use them; existing ones keep what they were created with.

subscription.title: Your plan
subscription.hint: Read-only. Changing plan goes through billing, which is not connected yet.
subscription.cancelling: Cancels at the end of the period

brand.title: Your company’s face
brand.note: This is what the customer sees when you send them a tracking link: on the page they open, and at the foot of the email that carries it. Nothing inside the app changes — your team still sees it as it is.
brand.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 2 MB. Shown on the public tracking page.
brand.emailFooterHint: Plain text: your address, your phone, whatever you want at the end. No markup — that text is read by somebody who knows neither you nor us, and a formatted block is what impersonators use.
brand.preview: This is the public page bar
brand.templateNote: Leave it blank and the standard one is sent. Available tokens: {tokens}.

templates.trackingLink: The wording of the tracking link email
templates.invoiceSent: The wording of the invoice email

brand.logoNotAnImage: That file is not a PNG, JPG or WEBP image. A logo is served on a public page, so only formats that cannot carry instructions inside are accepted.
brand.unknownTokens: This template uses {tokens}, which this email cannot fill: it would go out with the braces showing, in the email your customer reads. The ones it accepts are {allowed}.

webhook.title: Carrier signup webhook
webhook.note: When a carrier signs up on your public page, we POST the submission to a URL you choose, signed so you can verify it came from us.
webhook.urlHint: HTTPS only. Internal, loopback and link-local addresses are refused.
webhook.secretNone: No secret set. One is required before you can turn this on.
webhook.secretSet: A secret is set, ending ····{last4}. It is never shown again — replace it to change it.
webhook.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the current one
webhook.secretOnce: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.
webhook.enabled: Send a webhook on every carrier signup
webhook.enabledHint: Needs a destination URL and a secret.
webhook.sweepNeverRan: The delivery sweep has never run on this server, so nothing is being sent. It needs the scheduler cron line.
webhook.sweepStalled: The delivery sweep last ran on {date} and should run every minute. Nothing is being sent right now.
webhook.noRealDelivery: No real signup has been sent yet. A successful test says the URL works, not that signups are arriving.
webhook.abandoned: {count} delivery attempt(s) gave up after retrying. They were not received.

errors.scheme: The URL must start with https://.
errors.credentials: Remove the username and password from the URL.
errors.malformed: That is not a valid URL.
errors.dns: That host name does not resolve to any address.
errors.private_address: That address is on an internal, loopback or link-local network. Webhooks can only be sent to public addresses.
errors.incomplete: A destination URL and a secret are both required before turning this on.
